race.comment: ROJA CALIENTE (11) is a Home Affairs filly out of the handy mare Pedrena who debuts here for the McEvoy yard. She's jumped out well enough and the stable are always hard to beat here, go close. PRINCE OF PORTLAND (6) returned last time with a solid third at Pakenham Synthetic over 1000m. Sharper for that and will be very hard to hold out. BACK UP BARBIE (3) resumes, now with Ciaron Maher. She's placed in both runs to date and draws well, keeping safe with a nice profile. WHAT ONCE WAS (12) has shown ability in two runs so far, beaten under a length on debut before a close up fourth here last time. She'll be up on speed and giving a sight.
